description: Proposal (approved 2026-11-11): /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-structs-and-module-calls.html. Goal: Elixir's two facts hold in fz on interp, run and build: a struct is a map whose __struct__ key names a module, and a module is an atom that can be called (m.f(args), apply/3). Signal: Elixir-oracle fixtures from 00851 on for is_map/map_size/Map.*/map patterns/update on structs, and for calls on a module value. Prerequisite for fz-3ul.4 (defexception) so that it needs no protocol stand-in and no second exception representation. Order: S1 (runtime) and M1 now; S2 (types) after fz-sc8.99 lands; S3; M2; M3. Then defoverridable, fz-sc8.95, built-in exceptions in lib/, fz-3ul.4, the uncaught banner.
title: Structs are maps, and a module is a value you can call
